moneyline_model.verdict: DECENT - 63.3% but need odds data to determine profitability

improvements.name: Fix spread model overfit / Add closing line value (CLV)
improvements.impact: HIGH - Spread is currently WORSE than market. Either fix it or disable ATS betting
improvements.details: RMSE 14.2 vs market 12-13. Need: (1) More features (injuries, schedule, travel), (2) Regularization tuning, (3) Or pivot to using closing line value as a feature

improvements.name: Improve player props confidence calibration
improvements.impact: HIGH - The win_prob=1.0 issue means Kelly sizing is broken
improvements.details: During backtest, many predictions output win_prob=1.0 which is clearly wrong. The over/under classifier needs recalibration with Platt scaling or isotonic regression

improvements.name: Add opponent-adjusted player prop features
improvements.impact: MEDIUM - Current features are player-centric only
improvements.details: Need: (1) Opponent defensive rating vs position, (2) Opponent pace, (3) Game total/spread as context features, (4) Matchup history

improvements.name: Improve three-point model or disable threes betting
improvements.impact: MEDIUM - Model has no edge on threes (too random)
improvements.details: R²=0.31 and zero improvement over baseline. Either add shot selection/attempt features or disable threes prop betting

improvements.name: Implement bet selection filter
improvements.impact: HIGH - Only bet when edge is strongest
improvements.details: Even a 51% accurate model is profitable if you only bet the top 10% most confident predictions. Need: confidence thresholds, bet sizing based on edge

improvements.name: Add line shopping / market odds integration
improvements.details: Integrate real odds from The Odds API. Only bet when our predicted value significantly exceeds the market line
